posts.title: Weirdest fix yet: LG TV + pycast
posts.description: A television was once a predictable machine: signal go in, picture and sound come out. As with everything else whose character and shape has devolved into "black rectangle", our TVs have now got "apps" and "smart" nonsense all up in them. ...I'll skip over the part where I painstakingly go in and turn off every bit of gross nonsense that's turned on by default, from nauseating motion-smoothing to

posts.title: Happy Halloween!
posts.description: We grew a three-sisters garden this year, so some corn and beans found their way into the jack-o-lantern too. Happy Halloween! Go out and vote on Tuesday. There's clearly no limit on how scary things will get if we don't stop the ghouls NOW.

posts.title: Together 21 Years Today
posts.description: My brain will occasionally mix up "east" and "west", but not "left" and "right". My wife's brain occasionally swaps "left" and "right", but not "east" and "west". That's a pretty cute and accurate illustration of us as a couple. Together, we can navigate anywhere.
